newsitem.title: EU: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, FEB 3-SUNDAY, FEB 9 (PAGE 1/2 - MONDAY-TUESDAY).
newsitem.headline: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, FEB 3-SUNDAY, FEB 9 (PAGE 1/2 - MONDAY-TUESDAY).

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS

BRUSSELS - Romanian President Emil Constantinescu meets European Commission President Santer, European Commissioners van den Broek and de Silguy (Monday); meets NATO Secretary General Javier Solana, visits European Parliament (Tuesday).
THE HAGUE - Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok and Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo meet Palestinian President Yasser Arafat (Monday).
FRANKFURT - European Commissioner de Silguy attends European Monetary Institute Council (Tuesday).
BRUSSELS - European Policy Forum hosts speech by British Prime Minister John Major on "European business competitiveness" (Tuesday).
BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (Wednesday).

NOORDWIJK, Netherlands - EU ministers hold informal justice and home affairs meeting (Wednesday-Thursday); main discussions focus on the fight against organised crime, third pillar issues and the situation of the inter-governmental conference.
BRUSSELS - European Investment Bank President Brian Unwin holds news conference (Thursday).
THE HAGUE - Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok meets Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy (Thursday).
MONDAY, FEBRUARY 3
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Romanian President Emil Constantinescu meets European Commission President Santer, European Commissioners van den Broek and de Silguy.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
- (1500/1400 GMT) Foreign Affairs;
Agriculture;
Institutional Affairs;
Rules of Procedure;
Petitions.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Environment Bureau (EEB) holds news conference on "Memorandum to the Dutch presidency" (1130/1030 GMT). Issues include: the treaty revision; EU's role in climate protection; the fate of the fifth environmental action programme; the implementation of the auto-oil programme; the review of EU water policy and of the ecolabelling scheme. Venue: International Press Centre (IPC). Contact: EEB (322) 539 0037.
THE HAGUE (NEW ITEM) - Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok and Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo meet Palestinian President Yasser Arafat.
PORTUGAL and SPAIN (NEW ITEM) - Dutch Development Cooperation Minister Jan Pronk on official visit in framework of his European capital tour; discussions focus on the Dutch EU presidency agenda.
TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 4
FRANKFURT (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner de Silguy attends European Monetary Institute Council.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Romanian President Emil Constantinescu attends joint meeting of EP foreign affairs and external economic relations committees and EU-Romanian joint delegation at 1500/1400 GMT.
BRUSSELS - Following EP committees meet:
- (0900/0800 GMT) Agriculture;
Institutional Affairs;
Rules of Procedure;
Petitions;
Inquiry into Fraud in Transit;
- (0930/0830 GMT) Foreign Affairs - Dutch Foreign Minister
Hans Van Mierlo attends;
- (1500/1400 GMT) Budget;
Economic - Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit
Zalm attends;
External Economic Relations -
Commissioner Brittan attends;
Legal Affairs - Dutch State Secretary for
European Affairs Michiel Patijn attends;
Culture - Commissioner Oreja attends;
Civil Liberties;
Institutional Affairs;
Inquiry into Fraud in Transit.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - The European Consumer's Organisation (BEUC) holds news conference on "Crash test highlight urgent need for action at EU level" (1100/1000 GMT). Venue: Dorint Hotel. Contact: BEUC (322) 743 1590.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Policy Forum hosts speech by British Prime Minister John Major on "European business competitiveness" (1900/1800 GMT).
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Romanian President Emil Constantinescu meets WEU Secretary General Jose Cutileiro (0900/0800 GMT), meets NATO Secretary General Javier Solana (1700/1600 GMT);
THE HAGUE (MODIFIED ITEM) - Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov meeting with Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo to discuss EU-Russian relations HAS BEEN CANCELLED.
AUSTRIA (NEW ITEM) - Dutch Development Cooperation Minister Jan Pronk on official visit in framework his European capital tour; discussions focus on the Dutch EU presidency agenda.

LONDON (NEW ITEM) - European Automobile Manufacturers Association (ACEA) and the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders hold joint press lunch on motor vehicle safety (1245/1245 GMT). Venue: City Rhodes, New Street Square. Contact: ACEA (322) 735 5550.
(Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
